label: No actual concretum grounds itself under the selected grounding at w
paraphrase: OPEN analyst premise: under the selected grounding relation of the profile at w, no candidate that is concrete and exists at w grounds itself. Irreflexivity only: it says nothing about cycles of length two or more. Acyclicity including self-loops, and well-foundedness of grounding on actual concreta, each imply it. It must be read on the same strict sense of grounds as the closure premise STMT-EVERY-CONTINGENT-GROUNDED-AT, which permits self-grounding: under the reflexive existence-requirement reading of #1593 (ReflexiveDependenceScope) the closure holds trivially and irreflexivity fails.
